Question: salaamualeykum. hazrat i want to say that once it happened wid me dat i saw in dream or it was something else,i saw dat i woke up from my bed and i saw someone standing beside me in black long dress wid cap,i cant see its face due to darkness.. i realise that i am dreaming i want to open my eyes but unable to open it... in this dream i also saw dat a "heart" was inside my chadar..which was pumping very fast... dis was my dream,which i also know while dreaming ,i want to open my eyes but not able to move my hand... pls suggest Answer ID: 19416 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 234/214/H=1431) The dream indicates to laziness in performing good deeds and that the heart tends to evil deeds. Pay attention to rectify your soul, the dream serves as warning for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
